stackDivergence.rationale: Original source ownership and consumed native contracts are retained; host references, immutable XML/URI UTF16 fields and asynchronous ZIP transport bind browser execution around actual existing typed Any/OUString/PropertyValue owners.

preservedResponsibilities: Consumed paragraph/run groups, native CR finish protocol, three script families, typed character/paragraph properties and style toggle semantics. Imported-style values are read through DomainMapper_Impl, not Writer pooled-style UNO defaults. The represented non-numbered paragraph/run slice is partial; style application, numbering/table/section/theme managers and unconsumed property cases remain pending.

V4DQJW adds original kern modifier boolean projection nIntValue !=0, preserving the native minimum-size-threshold collapse (WRITER098). Word-only underline retains its separate true-only insertion and later-type behavior (WRITER099). The actual native item pool/UNO/primary storage path is now supported for these two bool properties.
omittedResponsibilities: Whole native module interfaces/ABI and unconsumed responsibilities are not claimed.
DOCX full model import/export, shell and UI integration remain in progress in V4DQJW.
